answer: Set Evaporation warden salt crystal mark countersigned by the pan record at the gate and the farm's arithmetic collapses: each salt crystal is a brine seal pressed beside the keepers mark, so a farm must. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 379 pays 6822 minutes every single epoch. Follow the echo back to the office that issued it, follow the wharf back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the beacon back to the year it was filed. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
